name: Enrolment Status 3
definition: Specifies the status of a creditor enrolment.

OriginalBusinessInstruction.name: Original Business Instruction
OriginalBusinessInstruction.definition: Unique identification of the original instruction.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Provides detailed information on the status for the request.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the status of the enrolment request.

OriginalEnrolmentReference.name: Original Enrolment Reference
OriginalEnrolmentReference.definition: Provides the original creditor enrolment data.

EffectiveEnrolmentDate.name: Effective Enrolment Date
EffectiveEnrolmentDate.definition: Actual date when the creditor enrolment was executed.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

OriginalEnrolmentPresenceRule.definition: When Status/Code is "Accepted" then OriginalEnrolmentReference must be present.
